★Request
Display Biko Pegasus (Summer Tracksuit)

Yeah! You know, the one we watched together the other day!
My favorite episode! "Carrotman: Pretty Debut!"

...Buuut, total failure! Haha, guess it's impossible after all~!!
The running style is completely different, isn't it?!
...Huh? Does that mean—
Pant... pant...!

(But even Trainer...
was praising Brian-san's running...)

I'm so happy!! After all—
I came to Tracen Academy because I wanted to be like Carrotman running on turf!!

A distinctive low center of gravity form,
and the physical dominance of a "champion" that enables daring positioning.

Heheh... Lately, you've been acting just like Captain Onion, Trainer!
The commander who encourages Carrotman with both strictness and kindness!!

Since I'm short, my stride reach is small,
so you told me I should compete with tight turns and stride cadence!!
....... ...I'm fine! I'll switch back next time!

The Event Tournament—where Umamusume compete under conditions of their choice.
At this rate, entering her into a turf race shouldn't be a problem at all!

A hero with no racing experience triumphs over the pros on the turf.
It seemed like an impossible challenge, but—

Leave it to me!!
Justice Biko never forgets a lesson!!

To me, Carrotman is the "ultimate hero"...
I looked up to him so much, and copied him all the time.
...She was so commanding, just like a hero.

Carrotman refused to give up, overtaking the other runners one by one.
It was a beautiful scene, watching Carrotman blaze straight across the lush green turf.
You said that, but...

And it wasn't just any practice race.
The one standing at the center of the crowd's gaze was—
...Yeah, you're right...!

Go! Rise up! Carrot~♪
Coursing through my veins~ is love~ and courage~♪ And ca-ro-tene~~♪

I recall what we watched in the trainer's room the other day. If I remember correctly,
it was the episode where Carrotman ran on the turf to cheer up a sick Umamusume.
...She was amazing...
—It was a truly ferocious run.

She saw something cool and tried to imitate it.
If that were all there was to it, it wouldn't be an issue, but...

...I can really run on turf...!!
Thank you, Trainer!!

Admiration for Captain Onion fires Carrotman up...
He wants to show him his best side!!

I wonder which one Trainer thinks
is the "cooler hero"...

I get the feeling there's more to it than that.
What could be going on...?

(Me, scurrying around with my tiny body, versus
Brian-san, running so cool and majestic...)

A wide-stride form coupled with aggressive course positioning.
You could say it's the exact opposite of her usual pitch-running style.

Some time has passed since I took over
supervising Biko Pegasus's training.
...! Yes, Captain!!
It's not dirt, it's not dirt... Don't forget that just 'cause you're getting used to it...!

Biko Pegasus expresses her joy with her whole body.
To make sure this momentum doesn't go to waste, maybe I should give her a little push.

So now that I can run on turf,
I feel like I'm one step closer to my "ultimate"... and that makes me so happy!

Well, you know... Brian-san looked so cool yesterday!
So I thought I'd, uh, try copying her a bit...
You know... I feel the exact same way!!

...Huh, aren't there a lot of people around?
Was there something going on today?

—Narita Brian. That remarkably prominent Umamusume
is a formidable rival whose debut is already set.

The next day—the time Biko Pegasus clocked
was an abysmal two seconds slower than the day before.

"No matter how reckless it seems... I'll never give up!!
I'm just getting started—!!"

I wanted to be a hero like that, someone who gives people courage...
I came here because I wanted to run like that!

Aided by Biko Pegasus's earnest and hardworking nature,
her transition from dirt to turf went smoothly.

Running with everything she had, tearing into the turf...
Heavy, powerful, commanding all the attention...

"You can run again. And to prove it—
I will make the impossible possible!!"

...Gah, no, no, no!!
What am I thinking?! There's no way I could copy that!!
One day, as the Event Tournament drew near—
—On our way back after finishing training.
